auth_type.correction: None for GET endpoints; HTTP Basic Auth using a Job Board API key is required for application-submission POST requests.

description.correction: Greenhouse Job Board API provides unauthenticated public GET endpoints for boards, jobs, offices, departments, and application fields. It is not entirely read-only or unauthenticated: submitting an application uses POST and requires HTTP Basic Auth with a Job Board API key.

notes: Official 2026 documentation confirms the HTTPS base path, GET listing pattern, JSON data, and public unauthenticated reads. The entry incorrectly characterizes the whole API as read-only and auth-free even though application submission is an authenticated POST. No authoritative Job Board documentation publishing CORS behavior, rate limits, or free-use limits was found.
